concerns.text: The project constitution (Principle I – Reproducibility) requires that all scripts pin random seeds, yet no task in the pipeline explicitly sets or records a random seed. Add a dedicated task (e.g., T021) to enforce seed setting in all relevant scripts or amend existing tasks to include this step.

FR‑008/FR‑009 expect a unit‑metadata file at `data/raw/adhesion_units.json`, but T003 creates `data/raw/adhesion_raw_units.json`. This filename mismatch prevents downstream validation of unit consistency. Rename the output to `adhesion_units.json` (or adjust all downstream references) and update the task description accordingly.
